response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.85. A human analyst still has to decide it.

**Three facts that drove it:**
1. T-X0929-01 is a registered market maker on SYN.A (desk ETF-MM). It re-quoted a 3642 SELL and a 728 BUY about every 3 seconds. Both sides were cancelled together and re-placed at the new touch as it fell from 10003 to 9997. Order size is the desk's typical 3642, and the largest resting order was only 1.47x depth, so no single order reached 3x depth.
2. All 9999 of executed quantity was on its own SELL quotes. There were no opposite-side (BUY) fills, no price move in the trader's favour and no round trip, so there was no benefit (feature (b)).
3. There was no public event in the window, no risk event, and no prior alerts on the trader in 90 days. The detector fired on gross resubmission size and the cancel ratio, which is normal quoting churn.

**What would change my mind:** a BUY execution by this trader at a price the SELL side had moved in his favour, followed by reversion. A one-sided order well above his typical size, or the same pattern on other sessions, would also change it.
